name: react-landing-page
description: An original responsive React landing-page demo with accessible navigation, FAQs and a local-only project brief. No client data, trackers or backend.

paragraphs: An original, responsive landing-page demonstration for Fieldnote Studio, a fictional creative studio. Built by Dhairya Sharma with AI-assisted development, this project demonstrates front-end implementation, clear product storytelling and privacy-conscious interaction design.
This is a portfolio concept, not client work. The miniature brands and design explorations are fictional. There are no real enquiries, commercial results, testimonials or live customer records.
Explore the interface, then read the design decisions, walkthrough and tested boundaries.
features: Introduction: editorial typography, a clear call to action and a code-built design preview.
Design explorations: three original layout directions, rendered with HTML/CSS rather than stock assets or external images.
Approach and FAQs: an accessible button-controlled accordion explaining the demo and its boundaries.
Project brief: a functional, local-only form that validates an imaginary project and displays a deterministic four-section outline.
